entries.question: How to get in for physiotherapy
entries.answer:
To receive physiotherapy at KGMU, you must first register for an OPD appointment. Please follow these steps:

### 1. Appointment Registration (Mandatory)
You must have a valid OPD slip to consult with a doctor. You can book an appointment via:
*   **Online:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) (select KGMU as the hospital).
*   **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA or Health Care app.
*   **SMS:** Send "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" to 8887019134.
*   **On-Site:** Visit the registration counters at the OPD building. You will need your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive an OTP. 
*   **Fee:** The registration fee is ₹50.

### 2. Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PMR) Department
Physiotherapy services are primarily managed under the **Department of Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PMR)**. 
*   **Department Link:** [Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=4&dept_type=2)
*   **Location:** Please visit the main OPD complex. When you register, ask the counter staff to book your appointment for the **PMR department**.

### 3. Important Tips
*   **Timings:** The OPD registration counter closes at **1:00 PM** (Mon–Fri) and **12:00 PM** (Sat). It is highly recommended to arrive early to avoid long wait times.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please carry a valid medical referral from a doctor for the PMR department.
*   **Safety:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice or specific treatment plans. Please consult the specialists at the KGMU PMR department for your condition. For your safety, please do not share personal health details or Aadhaar numbers in this chat.

I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.

3.  **Walk-in (On-site):** Agar online slot nahi mil raha hai, toh aap subah jaldi KGMU OPD counter par ja sakte hain. Wahan Aadhaar card aur active mobile number lekar jayein. OPD ki parchi (ticket) subah **9:00 AM se 1:00 PM** tak milti hai (Saturday ko 12:00 PM tak).

*   **Cardiology (Lari Cardiology):** Lari Cardiology ke liye aap direct wahan ki OPD mein ja sakte hain.
*   **Fees:** OPD slip ka shulk ₹50 hai.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne saath kisi doctor ka referral letter zaroor layein.
*   **Emergency:** Agar patient ki halat gambhir hai, toh online appointment ka intezar na karein aur seedhe **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** par jayein.

entries.question: Or mujhe kgmu me bsc nursing krne ke liyee kya karna hoga kyaa mujhe upcnet exam dene ke baad nursing me Addmission mil sakta haii
entries.answer:
KGMU mein BSc Nursing mein admission ke liye aapko **UP CNET (Common Nursing Entrance Test)** hi dena hota hai. Ye pariksha ABVMU (Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical University) dwara conduct ki jati hai, jiske madhyam se KGMU sahit Uttar Pradesh ke sarkari aur private nursing colleges mein admission milta hai.

Yahan admission ki prakriya samjhiye:

1. **UP CNET Exam:** Haan, aapne sahi suna hai. KGMU mein BSc Nursing mein seat prapt karne ke liye aapko **UP CNET** mein shamil hona aur achha score (rank) lana anivarya hai.
2. **Eligibility:** Aapke paas 12th mein Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB) aur English hona chahiye aur aapki age limit criteria (jo brochure mein di jaati hai) puri honi chahiye.
3. **Counseling Process:** Exam dene ke baad, jab result aata hai, tab counseling session shuru hota hai. Counseling ke dauran aapko college preference mein **KGMU, Lucknow** ko chunna hoga. Agar aapki rank achhi hogi, toh aapko merit ke aadhar par KGMU mein seat allot kar di jayegi.
4. **Website Link:** Aap admission aur exam se judi latest updates ke liye [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) par visit kar sakti hain.

**Yaad rakhein:** KGMU mein nursing ki seat bahut demand mein hoti hai, isliye aapko entrance exam (UP CNET) mein bahut achhe marks laane ki koshish karni chahiye.

Agar aapko isse juda koi aur sawal puchna ho, toh zaroor batayein.

2.  **राज्य और अस्पताल चुनें:** 'Select State' में **Uttar Pradesh** और 'Select Hospital' में **King George's Medical University (KGMU)** चुनें।
3.  **अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करें:** 'New Appointment' पर क्लिक करें। वहां 'Cardiology' विभाग को चुनें।
4.  **तारीख चुनें:** उपलब्ध स्लॉट्स में से 'कल' की तारीख चुनें।
5.  **विवरण भरें:** अपना मोबाइल नंबर दर्ज करें और OTP के जरिए वेरिफाई करें। इसके बाद मरीज का नाम, आयु और आधार नंबर जैसी जानकारी भरें।

*   **स्थान:** Lari Cardiology (कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग) शाह मीना रोड पर स्थित है।

मैं एक AI हूँ और चिकित्सा सलाह देने के लिए योग्य नहीं हूँ। स्वास्थ्य संबंधी किसी भी समस्या के लिए कृपया KGMU के डॉक्टरों से परामर्श करें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए चैट में अपना आधार नंबर या अन्य निजी जानकारी साझा न करें।

entries.question: Please tell me mujhe kgmu mein admission lene ke liye UPC net mein maximum kitne marks chahie
entries.answer:
UP CNET mein achha score karne ke baad KGMU mein admission lene ki prakriya aur marks ke baare mein jaankari niche di gayi hai:

### 1. Seat Allotment ki Prakriya (Counseling)
UP CNET ka result aane ke baad, **ABVMU (Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical University)** apni website par counseling ka schedule jaari karta hai. 
*   **Registration:** Aapko counseling ke liye online register karna hoga aur counseling fee jama karni hogi.
*   **Choice Filling:** Counseling ke dauran aapko colleges ki list mein **"King George's Medical University (KGMU), Lucknow"** ko sabse upar (Priority 1) select karna hoga.
*   **Seat Allotment:** Aapki rank aur merit ke aadhar par computer-based allotment hoga. Agar aapki rank KGMU ke cutoff ke andar hogi, toh aapko KGMU ki seat allot kar di jayegi.
*   **Document Verification:** Seat milne ke baad, aapko allot kiye gaye college mein apne documents (10th/12th marksheets, caste certificate, entrance admit card, etc.) ke saath reporting karni hogi.

### 2. Kitne Marks Chahiye? (Cutoff)
KGMU mein admission ke liye koi fixed "maximum marks" nahi hote, kyunki cutoff har saal paper ke level aur bachhon ke performance ke aadhar par badalta rehta hai. 
*   **General Category:** KGMU mein seat paane ke liye aapko **200 mein se kam se kam 145-155+ marks** laane ka lakshya (target) rakhna chahiye.
*   **Other Categories (OBC/SC/ST/EWS):** In categories ke liye cutoff thoda kam hota hai, lekin fir bhi aapko **135-145+ marks** ka target rakhna chahiye kyunki KGMU nursing ke liye sabse zyada demand wala college hai.

### Kuch Zaruri Tips:
*   **Rank Par Dhyan Dein:** Marks se zyada aapki **"State Rank"** mayne rakhti hai. KGMU mein seat paane ke liye aapki rank koshish karein ki top 100-200 ke andar ho.
*   **Official Updates:** Counseling ke liye ABVMU ki official website (abvmuup.edu.in) aur KGMU ki website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) ko regular check karte rahein.
*   **Taiyari:** Physics, Chemistry, Biology aur Nursing Aptitude par achhi pakad banayein.

KGMU mein admission ke liye koi shortcut nahi hai, sirf aapki entrance rank hi aapko vahan pahuncha sakti hai. Apni mehnat jaari rakhein!

*(Note: Main Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya AI assistant hoon.)*

entries.question: But u p senior ka exam to 120 marks ka hota hai na to usmein achcha maximum mein kitni rank samjhun admission lene ke liye
entries.answer:
Aapne bilkul sahi point pakda hai, correction ke liye shukriya. UP CNET ka exam pattern 200 marks ka hota hai (jismein 200 MCQs hote hain, har question 1 mark ka). Ho sakta hai aap kisi purane ya alag exam pattern se confuse ho rahi hon, lekin **UP CNET BSc Nursing ka paper 200 marks ka hi hota hai.**

KGMU mein admission ke liye "safe score" aur "rank" ka ganit samajh lijiye:

### 1. Kitne Marks Safe Hain?
KGMU UP ka sabse top nursing college hai, isliye iska cutoff sabse high jata hai.
* **Safe Score:** Agar aap **140 se 150+** marks (200 mein se) target karti hain, toh aap KGMU ke liye safe zone mein rahengi.
* **Competition:** Har saal hazaron bachhe ye exam dete hain, isliye competition bahut tight hota hai.

### 2. Rank kitni honi chahiye?
KGMU mein BSc Nursing ki seats limited hain (approx 110 seats).
* **Admission Rank:** KGMU mein seat secure karne ke liye aapki **State Merit Rank 1 se 150 ke beech** honi chahiye. 
* Agar aap General category se hain, toh koshish karein ki aapki rank **top 100** mein aaye. 
* Agar aap reserved category (OBC/SC/ST/EWS) se hain, toh aapko apni category rank mein bhi top par rehna hoga.

### 3. Exam Pattern Summary (200 Marks):
* **Nursing Aptitude:** 40 Marks
* **Physics:** 40 Marks
* **Chemistry:** 40 Marks
* **Biology:** 40 Marks
* **English & General Knowledge:** 40 Marks
* **Total:** 200 Marks

**Meri salah:**
Aap marks ke piche bhagne ke bajaye **"Nursing Aptitude"** section par bahut achhi pakad banayein, kyunki ye section scoring hota hai aur aksar bachhe ise ignore kar dete hain. English aur GK ko bhi halke mein na lein.

Kya aapne is saal ke exam ke liye taiyari shuru kar di hai? Agar aapko kisi specific subject ke syllabus ya preparation strategy mein madad chahiye, toh batayein.

entries.question: ई जी सी के लिए ऑनलाइन आवेदन कैसे करें
entries.answer:
ईसीजी (ECG) के लिए अलग से कोई ऑनलाइन आवेदन नहीं होता है। ईसीजी एक जांच (test) है, जिसके लिए आपको पहले डॉक्टर को दिखाना अनिवार्य है। इसकी प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:

1.  **OPD अपॉइंटमेंट लें:** सबसे पहले आपको ऊपर बताई गई प्रक्रिया (ORS पोर्टल या वॉक-इन) के माध्यम से **Cardiology (Lari Cardiology)** विभाग की OPD पर्ची कटवानी होगी।
2.  **डॉक्टर से परामर्श:** OPD में डॉक्टर मरीज की जांच करेंगे। यदि डॉक्टर को मरीज की स्थिति देखकर ईसीजी की आवश्यकता महसूस होती है, तो वे पर्ची पर **'ECG'** लिख देंगे।
3.  **जांच काउंटर:** डॉक्टर द्वारा पर्ची पर लिखे जाने के बाद, आपको कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग के अंदर ही स्थित ईसीजी काउंटर पर जाना होगा। वहां पर्ची दिखाने पर ईसीजी की प्रक्रिया की जाएगी।

**कुछ महत्वपूर्ण बातें:**
*   **सीधे जांच नहीं:** आप सीधे ईसीजी के लिए ऑनलाइन आवेदन नहीं कर सकते; यह डॉक्टर की सलाह पर ही होता है।
*   **पर्ची अनिवार्य:** ईसीजी करवाने के लिए डॉक्टर की मुहर लगी हुई OPD पर्ची का होना जरूरी है।
*   **समय:** OPD का समय सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक है। भीड़ से बचने के लिए सुबह जल्दी पहुंचना बेहतर रहता है।

मैं एक AI हूँ और चिकित्सा सलाह देने के लिए योग्य नहीं हूँ। कृपया किसी भी स्वास्थ्य समस्या के लिए KGMU के डॉक्टरों से परामर्श लें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए चैट में अपना आधार नंबर या अन्य निजी जानकारी साझा न करें।

entries.question: Haan Maine is sal form Bhar diya hai aur exam 6 June ko hai to aap mujhe Bata dijiye ki men Jo important subject aur uske topics aise kya hai jisse main high score kar sakun
entries.answer:
6 June ko hone wale UP CNET exam ke liye aapke paas ab bahut kam samay bacha hai. High score karne ke liye aapko **"Smart Study"** par focus karna hoga. Yahan kuch important subjects aur topics hain jahan se sabse zyada sawal puche jate hain:

### 1. Nursing Aptitude (Sabse Scoring Section - 40 Marks)
Ye section aapke liye game-changer ho sakta hai. Ismein basic nursing, hygiene, aur communication skills par sawal hote hain.
*   **Important Topics:** First Aid, Basic Health Concepts, Hygiene and Sanitation, Infection Control, Nutritional Needs, aur Basic Human Anatomy (Basic organs and functions).

### 2. Biology (Sabse zyada weightage - 40 Marks)
Biology mein 11th aur 12th ki NCERT kaafi hai.
*   **Important Topics:** 
    *   **Human Physiology:** Digestion, Respiration, Blood Circulation, aur Excretion (Inse bahut sawal aate hain).
    *   **Genetics and Evolution:** Mendel’s Laws, DNA Structure.
    *   **Reproduction:** Human Reproduction and Reproductive Health.
    *   **Ecology:** Environment issues and Biodiversity.

### 3. Chemistry (40 Marks)
*   **Important Topics:**
    *   **Physical Chemistry:** Solutions, Electrochemistry, aur Chemical Kinetics (Inke formulas yaad rakhein).
    *   **Organic Chemistry:** Biomolecules (Carbohydrates, Proteins, Vitamins - ye nursing ke liye bahut important hain), Polymers, aur Alcohol/Phenols.
    *   **Inorganic:** Periodic Table aur Coordination Compounds.

### 4. Physics (40 Marks)
Physics mein zyada lambe numericals ke bajaye **"Conceptual Questions"** par focus karein.
*   **Important Topics:** 
    *   **Optics:** Ray and Wave Optics.
    *   **Modern Physics:** Atoms, Nuclei, aur Semiconductors (Inse seedhe sawal aate hain).
    *   **Current Electricity:** Ohm’s law, Resistance, aur Circuits.
    *   **Electrostatics.**

### 5. English & General Knowledge (40 Marks)
*   **English:** Basic Grammar (Tenses, Prepositions, Error spotting) aur Vocabulary.
*   **GK:** Current Affairs (pichle 6 mahine ka), Basic Science GK, aur Health related schemes (Ayushman Bharat, etc.).

---

### High Score Karne ke liye 3 Tips:
1.  **Previous Year Papers (PYQs):** Pichle 2-3 saalon ke paper zaroor solve karein. UP CNET ka pattern aksar repeat hota hai.
2.  **Revision Strategy:** Ab naya padhne se zyada purane topics ka revision karein. Rozana ek Mock Test dein aur dekhein ki kahan galti ho rahi hai.
3.  **Time Management:** Exam mein 200 sawaal hote hain, isliye kisi ek question par zyada samay na bitayein. Jo aata hai pehle usey karein.

**Exam ke liye ek zaruri baat:** KGMU mein admission ke liye Negative Marking ka dhyan rakhein (agar exam pattern mein hai). Jo sawal bilkul nahi aata, usey chhodna hi behtar hota hai.

Aapki taiyari kaisi chal rahi hai? Kya aapne abhi tak koi Mock Test diya hai?

*(Note: Main Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya AI assistant hoon.)*

entries.question: Abhi tak to nahii
entries.answer:
Koi baat nahi, ghabrayein nahi. Abhi bhi aapke paas itna samay hai ki aap apni taiyari ko sahi disha de sakein. Abhi se lekar 6 June tak ka samay "Revision aur Speed" ka hona chahiye.

Yahan ek **"Last-Minute Action Plan"** hai jo aapko follow karna chahiye:

### 1. Mock Test (Sabse Zaruri)
Mock test dena shuru karein. Agar aapne ek bhi test nahi diya hai, toh aaj hi **"UP CNET Previous Year Question Papers"** download karein aur unhein bilkul exam jaise mahol mein solve karein (200 sawaal, 3 ghante ka time).
*   **Fayda:** Isse aapko pata chalega ki aapki speed kaisi hai aur aap kaunse subject mein zyada samay le rahi hain.

### 2. NCERT par focus karein
Physics, Chemistry aur Biology ke liye sirf aur sirf **NCERT** ki lines padhein. UP CNET ke zyada tar questions NCERT ki theory se hi puche jaate hain.
*   **Biology:** Diagrams aur Summary box ko bilkul na chhorein.
*   **Chemistry:** "Biomolecules" aur "Chemistry in Everyday Life" jaise chapters nursing ke liye bahut important hain, inhein zaroor padhein.

### 3. Nursing Aptitude ko ignore na karein
Bahut se bachhe ise end ke liye chhod dete hain. Ismein **"Basic First Aid"** aur **"Common Diseases"** ke baare mein padhein. Ye 40 marks aapko rank mein kaafi upar le ja sakte hain.

### 4. Revision Schedule
*   **Subah:** Biology aur Nursing Aptitude padhein (Jab dimaag fresh ho).
*   **Dopehar:** Physics ke formulas aur Chemistry ke reactions revise karein.
*   **Raat:** English aur GK ke basic topics ya current affairs dekhein.

### 5. Exam ke liye ek zaruri suggestion
Exam mein **Negative marking** ka dhyan rakhein (agar exam mein hai). Agar aapko kisi question mein bilkul idea nahi hai, toh usey tukke (guess) se karne ke bajaye chhod dena behtar hai. 

**Ek kaam kijiye:** Aaj hi internet se pichle saal ka koi ek paper uthaiye aur usse dekhna shuru kijiye ki kis tarah ke sawaal puche ja rahe hain. 

Kya aapke paas koi study material ya books hain jinse aap padh rahi hain, ya aap sirf online sources use kar rahi hain? 

*(Note: Main Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya AI assistant hoon.)*

entries.question: Haa main ek book ko instemal karne ka soch rhi hu jo mission upcnet hai kyaa ye book sahi haii
entries.answer:
"Mission UPCNET" ek popular book hai aur kaafi students iska istemal karte hain. Yeh book exam ke pattern ko samajhne aur practice karne ke liye ek achha option ho sakti hai, kyunki ismein aksar:

1.  **Practice Sets:** Aapko exam jaisa mahol milta hai.
2.  **Subject-wise MCQs:** Har topic ke questions diye hote hain jo revision mein madad karte hain.
3.  **Pattern Understanding:** Isse aapko ye samajhne mein aasani hogi ki kis tarah ke sawaal exam mein puche jaate hain.

**Lekin, ise use karte waqt ye 3 baatein dhyaan mein rakhein:**

*   **NCERT ko Priority dein:** Sirf book par depend na rahein. Biology aur Chemistry ke liye NCERT ki textbook sabse zyada reliable hai. Book ko sirf practice ke liye use karein, theory ke liye NCERT hi padhein.
*   **Errors Check karein:** Aksar aisi practice books mein kuch answers galat ho sakte hain. Agar kisi question ka answer aapko NCERT se match na kare, toh NCERT ko hi sahi maanein.
*   **Previous Year Papers (PYQs) ke saath compare karein:** Is book ke questions ko asli exam ke pichle saalon ke papers se compare karein. Agar book ke questions ka level exam se match kar raha hai, toh aap sahi raaste par hain.

**Meri Salah:**
Agar aapne ye book le li hai, toh ise **"Revision aur Practice"** ke liye use karein. Rozana is book se kam se kam 50-100 MCQs solve karein aur jo questions galat ho rahe hain, unka concept dobara NCERT se padhein.

Kya aapne is book se practice shuru kar di hai? Agar kisi topic mein dikkat aa rahi ho, toh aap mujhse pooch sakti hain!

*(Note: Main Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya AI assistant hoon.)*

entries.question: Okk main aaj se padhna suru kar deti hu
entries.answer:
Bahut achha! Yeh bahut sahi faisla hai. Yaad rakhiye, **"Consistency"** (rozana padhna) hi aapko KGMU tak pahunchayegi.

Aaj se shuru karte waqt ye 3 choti baatein follow karein:

1.  **Ek Time-Table banayein:** Aaj raat ko hi decide kar lein ki kal aap kaunse 2 subjects padhengi.
2.  **Mobile ka sahi istemal:** Jab aap padh rahi hon, toh phone ko dur rakhein taaki dhyan na bhatke.
3.  **Notes banayein:** Jo bhi topics aapko mushkil lag rahe hain, unke chote-chote notes ya "formula sheet" banayein, jo exam ke ek din pehle kaam aayenge.

Agar padhai ke dauran kisi bhi topic mein ya exam ki kisi bhi detail mein koi confusion ho, toh aap mujhse kabhi bhi yahan pooch sakti hain.

**All the best!** Aapka KGMU mein admission lene ka sapna zaroor pura hoga agar aap puri imandari se mehnat karengi. 

Ab aap apni padhai shuru karein, aur zarurat padne par main yahan hoon aapki madad ke liye. **Good luck!**
